us.h: Thanksgiving nor'easter forecast firms up; Northeast hubs face delays
us.s: The latest forecast brings heavy Southeast rain Wednesday, including around Atlanta, then heavy rain and strong gusts across the Mid-Atlantic and Northeast on Thanksgiving, with significant delays expected at every Northeast hub airport.

us.h: Appeals court opens path to erase Trump hush-money conviction
us.s: A 2nd Circuit panel ruled Trump's 34-count New York case can move to federal court, where he can seek dismissal on presidential-immunity grounds. The ruling pauses his state appeal.

us.h: Trump moves to speed federal executions, blasts Newsom
us.s: At the Justice Department, Trump ordered faster federal executions and death-penalty pursuits in child-murder, rape and trafficking cases, and attacked Newsom for commuting 548 California death sentences.

us.h: Court clears Iowa lead-explosive blast; Trump adds conditions
us.s: The 8th Circuit lifted its stay, and the Army plans Wednesday to detonate about 4.75 tons of degraded lead azide near Middletown, Iowa. Trump says Governor-elect Rob Sand must also agree.

us.h: Senate panel probes Vance role in Venezuela oil deal
us.s: Sen. Maggie Hassan is investigating whether Vance helped trader Vitol win lucrative Venezuelan crude sales after Maduro's ouster, seeking documents by Dec. 14. Vance's office denies a reported meeting.

world.h: Iran says tankers hit Hormuz mines, tightens strait closure
world.s: Iran's Revolutionary Guards claimed three US-escorted tankers struck mines in the Strait of Hormuz, unconfirmed by maritime monitors. Iran's army chief ordered tighter control as Qatar urged Washington to restart talks.

world.h: Russia warns Estonia it is nearing 'open war'
world.s: Moscow accused Tallinn of letting Ukrainian drones use its airspace and blocking Russian shipping, and summoned its envoy. Estonia denies it and will shut Russian border crossings Dec. 1; NATO is watching.

world.h: EU proposes 22nd Russia sanctions package, including sports ban
world.s: The European Commission proposed cutting 60 Russian banks from SWIFT, a crypto task force against evasion, a ban on Russian athletes competing under their flag, and visa refusals for war veterans. All 27 members must agree.

world.h: Zaporizhzhia strike kills two; Russian drone enters Polish airspace
world.s: A dawn Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia killed two and injured more than 40, including an infant. A Russian drone briefly crossed into Poland, which a Polish deputy minister called deliberate.

world.h: Gaza declares meningitis epidemic alert as strikes kill seven
world.s: Gaza's health ministry issued a territory-wide alert after meningitis cases hit 272 in October, about eight times normal. Israeli air strikes killed at least seven Palestinians, including a child.

world.h: South Korea issues air raid alert as Russian jets approach
world.s: About five Russian military aircraft entered South Korea's air defense zone near Ulleung Island. Seoul scrambled fighters, briefly told residents to shelter, and protested to Moscow.

tech.h: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang; stock surges more than 30%
tech.s: Nvidia's board brought Huang back as CEO less than two weeks after he resigned. Shares jumped over 30% and the Nasdaq had its best day since April 2025; federal probes continue.

tech.h: Amazon agrees to buy Decart AI tech for about $7.5B
tech.s: Amazon will acquire Decart's AI optimization technology and hire its founders and team in a cash deal reportedly near $7.5 billion, aiming for faster, cheaper AI on its custom chips. Regulators must approve.

tech.h: Bell says hackers accessed customer data in breach
tech.s: Canada's Bell said an intruder reached an internal system Nov. 17, exposing names, addresses, phone numbers and account details for Bell, Virgin Plus and Lucky Mobile customers. No banking data was taken, it says.

tech.h: Ariane 6 launches 36 Amazon Leo internet satellites
tech.s: Ariane 6 lifted off from French Guiana Tuesday with 36 Amazon Leo satellites after a one-day scrub, Amazon's first launch since a Vulcan failure destroyed 40 of its satellites on Nov. 15.

tech.h: Meta backs away from its 2030 net-zero target
tech.s: Meta's sustainability report says it is re-evaluating its 2030 net-zero timeline after emissions more than doubled in four years, driven by AI data centers and new natural-gas power.

tech.h: Meta AI chief warns superintelligence is 'arriving'
tech.s: Meta Chief AI Officer Alexandr Wang said superintelligence is imminent and self-improving AI may be impossible to control, urging an approach that gives people more agency.

talking.h: Wind could ground balloons at Macy's 100th parade
talking.s: AccuWeather expects 20–30 mph gusts for Thursday's parade, near New York City's limits for flying the giant balloons, with winds strengthening late and rain arriving around midday.

talking.h: Ilhan Omar search-warrant records partly unsealed
talking.s: Judge Boasberg released 169 heavily redacted pages tied to the FBI search of Omar's D.C. home, reportedly involving citizenship and marriage questions. Omar has not been charged and calls the probe political.

talking.h: Commanders stun Bengals with walk-off field goal
talking.s: Jayden Daniels drove Washington 64 yards in three plays after Cincinnati's late go-ahead score, and Drew Stevens kicked his fifth field goal at the gun for a 22-20 Monday night win.

coming.h: Inflation, GDP, jobless claims all land Wednesday
coming.s: October core PCE, the Q3 GDP revision, weekly jobless claims and durable goods arrive at 8:30 a.m. ET, with the Fed's Beige Book at 2 p.m.
Bears at Lions (1 p.m. ET, CBS), Eagles at Cowboys (4:30, FOX) and Chiefs at Bills (8:20, NBC). Stock markets, banks and post offices are closed.

coming.h: Black Friday; stocks close early at 1 p.m.
coming.s: Holiday shopping kicks off, markets run a shortened session, and Broncos at Steelers airs at 3 p.m. ET on Prime Video.
The biggest online shopping day closes out the holiday weekend.

coming.h: Rep. Jimmy Gomez's resignation takes effect
coming.s: The California Democrat leaves Congress after a House Ethics report found substantial evidence of sexual misconduct toward a staffer; he denies wrongdoing.
